channel.title: Australian Mountain Bike Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Australian Mountain Bike Magazine (ambmag.com.au)

item.title: Rolik Mountain Bike Apparel Review | Sunshine Coast MTB Brand
item.description: Sunshine Coast brand Rolik delivers trail-tested mountain bike apparel built for everyday riders, balancing durability, comfort and value.

item.title: Queensland E-Bike Laws 2026: What It Means for Mountain Bikers
item.description: Queensland’s e-mobility inquiry could introduce age limits and licensing for e-bikes. Here’s what it means for mountain bikers.

item.title: Recovery Made Easy? Flow Nutrition Bars Tested - Australian Mountain Bike
Warburton Bike Park Expansion: 70km of Trails and Shuttle Access
item.description: Warburton Bike Park will expand to over 70km of trails with shuttle uplift launching April 2026, making the Yarra Valley a major MTB destination.

item.title: Why Local MTB Trails Are the Heart of Australian Mountain Biking
item.description: Local mountain bike trail networks are where riders start, skills grow and communities form. Here’s why they’re vital to the future of Australian MTB.

item.title: Pirelli Cinturato Gravel M vs Gravel H Review | Gravel Tyre Test
item.description: We test the Pirelli Cinturato Gravel M and Gravel H tyres to see how they handle fast gravel roads and technical trail sections.

item.title: FOX FLOAT X and DHX Update: Live Valve Neo and New Internals
item.description: FOX updates FLOAT X and DHX shocks with new internals and Live Valve Neo options, delivering improved sensitivity, support and trail performance.

item.title: Gravel n Granite 2026: Tenterfield Gravel Cycling Event Guide
item.description: Gravel n Granite returns to Tenterfield in May 2026 with multiple race distances, epic terrain and a festival atmosphere for all riders.

item.title: Australian Mountain Bike Issue 216: What’s Inside the Latest Issue
item.description: AMB Issue 216 is out now, featuring Swiss Alps adventure, new bike tests, emerging tech and a look at the future of mountain biking.

item.title: 2026 MTB National Champs Results: Hoskin & Mawson Win Gold
item.description: Jess Hoskin and Nathan Mawson claim gold at the 2026 MTB National Champs at Mt Buller, with strong performances in e-bike XCO and team relay.
